added_lines: by December 4th. Upcoming Festive Events! A Little Help This Christmas? Christmas can be a particularly difficult time for some individuals and families, especially when faced with worries about food, heating or making ends meet. If you, or someone you know, may be struggling at this time and could use a little help, please do not hesitate to reach out to Fr. Seán or the Parish Office. Whether it is assistance with food, heating or another difficulty, we will do our best to help in whatever way we can. Any request for assistance will be treated with care and complete confidence. As a parish community, let us continue to look out for one another, particularly at this special time of year. Sometimes the greatest gift we can offer is simply a helping hand, a listening ear or the reassurance that nobody is forgotten. Dromod/Waterville

Thought for the Week – Christ the King, Jesus is a King who rules not from a throne, but through gentle service as our Good Shepherd. In today’s Gospel, he reminds us that whenever we care for the lonely, the hungry, o r the struggling, we are caring for him. As the Church year ends, may we look for Christ’s face in our neighbours this week. Moderator: Canon John Fitzgerald (029) 70043 / 087 77 52 948 Secretary : Michelle O’Sullivan

Thought for the day: To engage with today’s readings, it might be helpful to go back in your own mind to someone in your life whom you regard as really wise.
When did you become aware of it? Have you benefitted from it?
If someone were to ask how would you recognise wisdom and what are its marks, what would you say?
Have you learned from your encounters with wise people?
Do you desire wisdom for yourself? Perhaps as parent or friend or family member or colleague.
Do you nourish your hunger for the qualities and attitudes which we associate with people who have learned from life?
Prayer: All-wise and loving God, the desire for you lies deep within us.
Awaken us to the quest for true wisdom that by being true to ourselves we may come home to you, the source of all wisdom.
Amen. (
